internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every attested token of this root lives in one verse, 58:11 (al-Mujādila), in one scene: believers are told to make room in the sitting-assemblies (majālis), and God promises to make room for them in return. The narrowest reading that carries all three tokens is 'make/create accommodating space, open up room.' The Form V verb (تَفَسَّحُوا۟) and the Form I verb (فَٱفْسَحُوا۟) name and then execute the SAME act inside one sentence, which shows the form difference is valency/aspect (mutual-distributive vs plain), not two meanings. The divine token (يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ) mirrors the human act, so the root's reciprocal figure only works if it is one nucleus deployed across domains. The account is clean and morphologically triangulated within the scene, and it is sharply distinguished inside the verse from n-sh-z (rise/move up) and r-f-ʿ (raise in rank). It is capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE purely by breadth: the entire evidence base is a single verse and a single event, so no cross-context adversarial test is possible, and the divine token leaves a concrete-vs-abstract residue.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Quran-internally (all from 58:11's contrast set): fsH does NOT entail rising/moving up (contrasted directly with ٱنشُزُوا۟, n-sh-z); does NOT entail elevation or promotion in rank (the verse assigns raising-in-degrees to a different root, يَرْفَعِ … دَرَجَٰتٍ, r-f-ʿ, for a different trigger); does NOT entail vacating or departing (it is accommodation while remaining in place); carries no temporal sense.
